prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Noor Halden for the job below.

About the freelancer: 6 years experience; skills: Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, machine learning

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: Help with my website and Youtube Channel
I have one website and Youtube channel that I will be using to promote my local city and my business for touring/sightseeing/black car service. Before I start creating content for this website and channel, I need someone who can help me come up with the best option/strategy to achieve my goals. This person must be an expert in SEO optimization, keywords selection, Google Adsense, YouTube, marketing and of course a business oriented person. Any skills necessary for what I am looking for would also be appreciated.
</job>

- Mention these projects by what was built and one result each: Card fraud scoring API (p10); Invoice field extraction (p04).

Output only the proposal text. Never add contact details or links.
text:
Hi, I’m Noor Halden, and I’m passionate, hard-working, and focused on building practical systems that help businesses make smarter decisions.

I’d love to help you shape the best strategy for your website and YouTube channel before you start publishing content. From your description, you need more than content ideas—you need a business-minded plan that connects SEO, keyword selection, YouTube growth, Google Adsense, and your local tourism/sightseeing goals into one clear direction. That’s the kind of problem I enjoy working on.

I bring 6 years of experience working with Python, machine learning, NLP, and related tools, and I’ve built solutions that had to be accurate, efficient, and useful in real business settings. For example, I built a card fraud scoring API that reads card events from Kafka and returns a fraud score before authorization, with p95 latency of 38 ms and fraud losses down 22% during the pilot. I also built an invoice field extraction service that reads scanned supplier invoices and returns structured JSON, reaching 96.2% field-level accuracy on 1,800 test invoices and cutting manual data entry by about 70%.

While those projects were technical, the same approach applies here: understand the goal, identify the best opportunities, and create a strategy that is realistic and effective. For your website and YouTube channel, I can help you think through content structure, keyword opportunities, search intent, channel positioning, and how to align everything with your business goals so your audience can actually find you.

I’m comfortable with SEO-oriented thinking, data-driven planning, and turning broad business goals into a practical action plan. If helpful, I can also help you organize your initial content strategy so you start with a clear roadmap instead of guessing what to publish.

If you want someone who can combine technical problem-solving with a business-first mindset, I’d be glad to work with you and help set a strong foundation for your website and channel.
